From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 22 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Thanks for signing up — 15 minutes if you'd like a walkthrough

Hi Sarah —

Thanks for signing up for Redwood Inference! I wanted to confirm we received your self-serve registration and share a short, optional 15-minute walkthrough if you'd like a quick tour tailored to retail use cases. No pressure — the product works fine without this, but most teams find a short live walkthrough helpful to see latency/cost dashboards and model routing in action.

If that'd help, pick a time here: https://cal.redwood.ai/b/naomi_feldman/15min or reply with a couple of windows that work in your timezone.

Attached is a two-page "demo brief" with a suggested agenda and questions we typically cover (focus on integrations, throughput, and data controls).

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Inbound SDR, Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.com

Attachment: demo-brief.pdf (PDF, 185 KB)
